what: A stack of three sticky notes almost piled on top of each other (front note 0° · second note up and right 10,−8px 2.07° · third note down and left −8,12px −3.37° at .965 scale). When the pointer hovers, the three notes fan out in three directions (−56,−52px −10° · 56,−42px 12° · −50,46px −14°), and the way there and back takes .48s sine.inOut. On press, the whole stack slides out past the left of the screen (the largest of right edge+32px, 1.1× width and 560px) in .75s power2.inOut and fires fx:open. Sending fx:reset returns the stack to its resting place.

options.out: Exit length after press (sec), default .75 — 0 fires fx:open right away
options.--fx-note: Note color — set per note via style
options.fx:open: Event the group element emits after everything has exited — the question card and contact panel appear at this point
options.fx:reset: Send to the group and it returns to place
options.lag: Delay in seconds before moving after the hand enters or leaves, default 0 — parker .05

note: The original shrinks 465×706 cards to 166×200 to form a stack and enlarges them to original size on open — here the notes are drawn at 166×200 directly

from.where: index.html·contact.html inquiry section .ps-deck__cluster — original InquiryCtaStack + InquireForm (phase idle·hover·opening)
